## What is R-Parity Violating SUSY?

33

In Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (MSSM), R-parity violating (RPV) couplings arise from terms that violate Lepton or Baryon number

As a result LLPs are a generic result of RPV theories!

## Compressed Higgsino Search

• Two searches for electroweak SUSY

production with compressed mass spectra

• 1L1T := 1 soft lepton + 1 soft track,

lepton identified with electron or muon taggers based on neural networks

• Displaced track := pions with large

transverse impact parameter (displacement) due to long(ish) higgsino lifetime (c𝛕 ~ O(0.3-1) mm)

• Surpass limits by LEP in very

challenging region!

48

arXiv:2511.20042
